items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We had Buck Clayton, Ed Lewis, Shad Collins, and Harry Edison.

ctx.x: We had Buck Clayton, Ed Lewis, Shad Collins, and Harry Edison. We had four trumpets now. Now we're building up the brass section; reed sections stay the same. Then we begin to build up and here you had Benny Morton, you had Dan Minor, you know -
That makes for a brass section -

items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So then we played with three trumpets, one trombone, that's four, two reeds, that's six and Page, Jo and Basie that's nine.

ctx.x: Buster Smith, yes we call him Prof. Yes. You see, he went to Texas. So then we played with three trumpets, one trombone, that's four, two reeds, that's six and Page, Jo and Basie that's nine. That's the way it was when I came there. And later, I sent, we sent for Caughey and Herschel. They came in. But it was nine pieces when I first went there.
